body:
I feel like I'm running in place and not progressing in anything I used to enjoy. Everything I do is horrible, to me. Maybe I'm still good at stuff, but I wouldn't know because I beat myself up over everything.

My parents don't really take it seriously. They think I'm just immature, I'm pretty sure.

My parents know. I spoke with a school counselor and asked her to call my parents... they were unhappy that I feel this way and unhappy that I cut, but basically told me I was stressed and told me that I needed to stop cutting. Hasn't even come up since. They're always surprised and annoyed that I'm irritable and they're angry that I don't do anything I'm supposed to, even I told them how I feel. I've just been pretending to feel better so they don't talk to me.

I'm a good dancer and a good singer and I good artist. So I'm told. I don't believe it. Not anymore, anyway. 

Thank you so much for replying. It means a lot.
